Riya identified shared values and forms across retold stories and festivals.

Venn-diagram comparison needs more practice; teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Riya practised finding common threads across different languages, festivals, foods, and clothing, and used comparison examples such as Lohri–Pongal and dosa–chilla. The method of separating “same” and “different” was used, but placing details in a Venn diagram still needs practice. At home, choose two festivals or foods and draw two circles together, adding one shared point in the overlap and two different points outside it.
